SELECT telemetry_id, device_id, data_key, data_value, unit, record_time, CASE data_key WHEN 'SoilMoisture' THEN '土壤水分' WHEN 'soiltemperature' THEN '土壤温度' WHEN 'SoilElectricalConductivity' THEN '土壤电导率' WHEN 'temperature' THEN '温度' WHEN 'humidity' THEN '湿度' WHEN 'illuminance' THEN '光照度' WHEN 'windspeed' THEN '风速' WHEN 'winddirection' THEN '风向' ELSE '未知' END AS data_key_chinese FROM iot_telemetry WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY record_time DESC limit 8
SELECT * FROM iot_telemetry WHERE data_key = #{dataKey} ORDER BY record_time DESC limit 8
SELECT * FROM iot_telemetry WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND record_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY record_time DESC limit 8

SELECT t1.* FROM iot_telemetry t1 " + "INNER JOIN (SELECT data_key, MAX(record_time) as max_time FROM iot_telemetry WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} GROUP BY data_key) t2 " + "ON t1.data_key = t2.data_key AND t1.record_time = t2.max_time " + "WHERE t1.device_id = #{deviceId}

SELECT telemetry_id, device_id, data_key, data_value, unit, record_time FROM iot_telemetry WHERE data_key IN ('windspeed', 'winddirection') ORDER BY record_time DESC, FIELD(data_key, 'winddirection', 'windspeed') LIMIT 2;

WITH MinuteData AS ( SELECT DATE(record_time) AS record_date, HOUR(record_time) AS hour_of_day, MINUTE(record_time) AS minute_of_hour, device_id, data_key, AVG(data_value) AS avg_value, unit FROM iot_telemetry WHERE DATE(record_time) = (SELECT MAX(DATE(record_time)) FROM iot_telemetry) GROUP BY DATE(record_time), HOUR(record_time), MINUTE(record_time), device_id, data_key, unit ) SELECT device_id, record_date, CONCAT(LPAD(hour_of_day, 2, '0'), ':00') AS time_format, data_key, CASE WHEN data_key = 'temperature' THEN '温度' WHEN data_key = 'humidity' THEN '湿度' WHEN data_key = 'illuminance' THEN '光照度' WHEN data_key = 'windspeed' THEN '风速' WHEN data_key = 'winddirection' THEN '风向' WHEN data_key = 'soilmoisture' THEN '土壤水分' WHEN data_key = 'soiltemperature' THEN '土壤温度' WHEN data_key = 'soilelectricalconductivity' THEN '土壤电导率' ELSE data_key END AS data_key_chinese, ROUND(AVG(avg_value), 4) AS hourly_avg_value, unit, COUNT(*) AS minute_count FROM MinuteData WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} and data_key = #{telemetryName} GROUP BY record_date, hour_of_day, device_id, data_key, unit ORDER BY device_id, hour_of_day, data_key;

WITH RECURSIVE WeekDates AS ( SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY AS date_value, 1 AS weekday_order, '星期一' AS day_chinese UNION ALL SELECT date_value + INTERVAL 1 DAY, weekday_order + 1, CASE weekday_order + 1 WHEN 2 THEN '星期二' WHEN 3 THEN '星期三' WHEN 4 THEN '星期四' WHEN 5 THEN '星期五' WHEN 6 THEN '星期六' WHEN 7 THEN '星期日' END FROM WeekDates WHERE weekday_order < 7 ), DeviceList AS ( SELECT DISTINCT device_id FROM iot_telemetry WHERE YEARWEEK(record_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1) ), TempData AS ( SELECT device_id, DATE(record_time) AS record_date, AVG(data_value) AS avg_value, MIN(data_value) AS min_value, MAX(data_value) AS max_value, COUNT(*) AS record_count, unit FROM iot_telemetry WHERE YEARWEEK(record_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1) AND data_key = 'temperature' GROUP BY device_id, DATE(record_time), unit ) SELECT d.device_id, w.date_value AS record_date, w.day_chinese, w.weekday_order, '温度' AS data_key_chinese, COALESCE(ROUND(t.avg_value, 4), 0) AS avg_temperature, COALESCE(t.unit, '°C') AS unit, COALESCE(t.record_count, 0) AS record_count, YEARWEEK(w.date_value, 1) AS week_number FROM DeviceList d CROSS JOIN WeekDates w LEFT JOIN TempData t ON d.device_id = t.device_id AND w.date_value = t.record_date WHERE d.device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY d.device_id, w.weekday_order;

WITH RECURSIVE WeekDates AS ( SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY AS date_value, 1 AS weekday_order, '星期一' AS day_chinese UNION ALL SELECT date_value + INTERVAL 1 DAY, weekday_order + 1, CASE weekday_order + 1 WHEN 2 THEN '星期二' WHEN 3 THEN '星期三' WHEN 4 THEN '星期四' WHEN 5 THEN '星期五' WHEN 6 THEN '星期六' WHEN 7 THEN '星期日' END FROM WeekDates WHERE weekday_order < 7 ), DeviceList AS ( SELECT DISTINCT device_id FROM iot_telemetry WHERE YEARWEEK(record_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1) ), TempData AS ( SELECT device_id, DATE(record_time) AS record_date, AVG(data_value) AS avg_value, MIN(data_value) AS min_value, MAX(data_value) AS max_value, COUNT(*) AS record_count, unit FROM iot_telemetry WHERE YEARWEEK(record_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1) AND data_key = 'humidity' GROUP BY device_id, DATE(record_time), unit ) SELECT d.device_id, w.date_value AS record_date, w.day_chinese, w.weekday_order, '湿度' AS data_key_chinese, COALESCE(ROUND(t.avg_value, 4), 0) AS avg_temperature, COALESCE(t.unit, '°C') AS unit, COALESCE(t.record_count, 0) AS record_count, YEARWEEK(w.date_value, 1) AS week_number FROM DeviceList d CROSS JOIN WeekDates w LEFT JOIN TempData t ON d.device_id = t.device_id AND w.date_value = t.record_date WHERE d.device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY d.device_id, w.weekday_order;
